description: Locations and characteristics of electricity substations (33 kV or larger), Great Britain, 2018 is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Environmental Information Data Centre. The data consists of names, types, voltages, constraint status and national grid references for 56,865 electricity substations (33 kV or larger) in Great Britain in 2018. It was compiled from information on individual transmission or distribution network operator websites and interpreted to produce a classification of constraint status (where applicable). Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Environmental Information Data Centre. Its tags are Electricity Network, Electricity Network Capacity Constraints, Electricity Substations, Energy Resources, Substation Locations. It offers 2 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
